PRAVEESH
CHANDRA

Praveesh Chandra is a renowned artist from Thrissur who turned his struggles into inspiration through art.

About the Artist & His Journey

He was diagnosed with Spinal Muscular Dystrophy (SMD) at the age of five, which affected his mobility and prevented him from attending school like other children. Because of his condition, he was homeschooled till Class 10.

Despite many physical and emotional challenges, Praveesh never gave up. Art became his passion and source of strength. His interest in drawing from childhood later inspired him to complete a five-year course in painting and drawing.

Most of his artworks are created using acrylic colors and are inspired by nature, landscapes, portraits, and imagination. He believes that art should come from the heart and paints whatever inspires him emotionally.

Over the years, Praveesh has created more than 1000 paintings and conducted several exhibitions across Kerala, including an international exhibition in Dubai.

Inspiration and Message

Praveesh has been using a wheelchair for the past several years, but he continues to move forward with confidence and determination. His wife and daughter have always supported and encouraged him throughout his journey.

Even though his hands are becoming weaker due to his condition, he has not lost hope. He plans to learn foot and mouth painting so that he can continue creating art in the future.

Praveesh strongly believes that disability exists only in people's attitude and not in their abilities. His life is a powerful example of courage, passion, and perseverance.

Inspiring Quote
"A disability is only in people's attitude. Smile at everyone."
Theme of the Painting: Kathakali

This painting portrays the beauty and cultural richness of Kathakali, one of the most famous traditional art forms of Kerala. Kathakali is a classical dance-drama known for its elaborate costumes, colorful makeup, expressive facial movements, and storytelling performances based on Indian epics such as the Ramayana and Mahabharata.

The vibrant colors, detailed ornaments, and powerful expressions in this artwork reflect the emotion, strength, and elegance associated with Kathakali performances. The painting beautifully captures the spirit of Kerala's cultural heritage while also showcasing the remarkable artistic talent of Praveesh Chandra.
